claim: Apple's HealthKit documentation says HealthKit stores HRV as SDNN, the standard deviation of the intervals between normal heartbeats, typically in milliseconds.
quote: While there are multiple ways of computing HRV, HealthKit uses SDNN heart rate variability, which uses the standard deviation of the inter-beat (RR) intervals between normal heartbeats (typically measured in milliseconds).

claim: Apple says only that the system records the samples on Apple Watch; the identifier page states no measurement window or time of day.
quote: The system automatically records samples on Apple Watch.

claim: Health Connect's HRV record is RMSSD.
quote: Captures user's heart rate variability (HRV) as measured by the root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD) between normal heartbeats.

claim: Health Connect's HRV value is in milliseconds, with a valid range of 1 to 200.
quote: Heart rate variability in milliseconds. Required field. Valid Range: 1-200.

claim: Google Health API's daily HRV gives an average RMSSD.
quote: A user's average heart rate variability calculated using the root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD) in times between heartbeats.

claim: Google Health API's daily HRV also carries a separate RMSSD for deep sleep.
quote: The root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD) value during deep sleep.

claim: Google Health API's HRV sample type may hold RMSSD or SDNN.
quote: Captures user's heart rate variability (HRV) as measured by the root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD) between normal heartbeats or by standard deviation of the inter-beat intervals (SDNN).

claim: Fitbit's Web API reference says its daily HRV value is RMSSD in milliseconds.
quote: The Root Mean Square of Successive Differences (RMSSD) between heart beats. It measures short-term variability in the user’s daily heart rate in milliseconds (ms).

claim: Fitbit's HRV applies to the main sleep, the longest sleep period of the date.
quote: HRV data applies specifically to a user’s “main sleep,” which is the longest single period of time asleep on a given date.

claim: Fitbit provides the HRV value at the end of a sleep period.
quote: The measurement is provided at the end of a period of sleep.

claim: Fitbit collects HRV only after at least three hours of sleep.
quote: the user must have a minimum of 3 hours of sleep.

claim: Fitbit also returns a deep-sleep RMSSD.
quote: It measures short-term variability in the user’s heart rate while in deep sleep, in milliseconds (ms).

claim: Oura's API reference describes its HRV field only as an average during sleep, without naming the statistic or the unit.
quote: Average heart rate variability during sleep.

claim: Oura's sleep record also carries HRV samples.
quote: Object containing heart rate variability samples.

claim: Oura's samples carry their own sampling interval.
quote: Interval in seconds between the sampled items.

claim: Oura's readiness reports HRV balance as a 1 to 100 contribution, not a value in milliseconds.
quote: Contribution of heart rate variability balance in range [1, 100].

claim: WHOOP's Recovery reports HRV as RMSSD in milliseconds.
quote: The user's Heart Rate Variability measured using Root Mean Square of Successive Differences (RMSSD), in milliseconds.

claim: WHOOP calculates Recovery when the member wakes up.
quote: When you wake up in the morning, WHOOP calculates a Recovery score as a percentage between 0 - 100%.

claim: Each WHOOP Recovery is tied to a sleep.
quote: ID of the Sleep associated with the Recovery

claim: Garmin's public Health API page lists heart rate, sleep and stress among its metrics and names no HRV statistic.
quote: Steps Intensity Minutes Sleep Calories Heart Rate Stress Pulse Ox Body Battery Body Composition Respiration Blood Pressure

claim: Garmin's beat-to-beat interval feed is marked as Enterprise Access only.
quote: Supported with Enterprise Access only

claim: Google Health API dates each daily HRV value in the user's time zone.
quote: Date (in the user's timezone) of heart rate variability measurement.

claim: Each Health Connect HRV record carries a single time.
quote: Time the record happened.
